label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Good evening Marek, and thank you for preparing the lineup.

As Liliana's coach I would like to ask you to look at it again before Friday. I was not consulted, and in your message from 1 October you wrote that coaches of the players will be consulted before the final lineup. So I hope it is still possible to discuss it now.

In the same message the criteria were the November FIDE list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier on 24 October. With both criteria together, I think the picture is different:

- In the qualifier Liliana finished 2nd with 5.5/7. She beat Maja and Antoni and drew with Kacper. Igor finished 4th with 4/7.
- On the November list the difference between Liliana (1851) and Igor (1874) is only 23 points. As Joanna noted, Liliana's -81 comes only from the Katowice open. She was already not well there for health reasons, but she still played all the games. I don't think this result shows her real strength.
- After Katowice she missed about two weeks of training, also for health reasons. She is now back to her normal level, and her last three lessons were very good.

I want to be clear that this is not against Igor. He is a good player and he has worked well this autumn, as Rafael said. My point is only about the rule we announced. If the rating list alone decides the lineup, the qualifier did not count, and the players and parents were told it would.

My proposal is Liliana on board 2. If you prefer to check current form directly, I am also happy with a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday, for example two rapid games. I can organise it any day this week that suits both of them.

Of course I will accept your decision after this. But I would be grateful if we could agree on it together before the names go to the organisers.

Best regards,
Oksana
